{{Quote|No longer will we be restricted to our territory, forced to share with the other bosses. Tonight, with your help, there will be only one boss&hellip;and you will be her favored few!|Traygura|<ref name="TSC" />}}
'''Traygura''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], in a bid to eliminate the other crime bosses she hired the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal [[T'mott Zoat]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tracked Zoat to [[Traygura's hideout|Traygura's base]] but was captured when his guide, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] betrayed Kenobi to Traygura in exchange for becoming her personal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. She was captured when Kenobi's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] companions [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Skirmish at Traygura’s Hideout|rescued]] Kenobi.<ref name="TSC" />
